instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the events in a time range from one of the person's own Google calendars and give them back as time blocks", and give it range_start (ISO time the range starts); range_end (ISO time the range ends).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-google-calendar-events and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Asks Google for the events of one calendar between two times (every occurrence of a repeating event, in start order) with the person's own Google OAuth client id, client secret and refresh token, and gives them back as time blocks that read-time-blocks and lay-out-a-calendar-view understand.
